Knowledge facts: part C holds 36 fact blocks (sec04-F01 onward) from physical pages 22 to 25; part C2 holds 15 confusable and continuation blocks (sec04-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the back-cover publication line, the two-component structure and the 80 percent per-component passing standard from physical pages 1, 10, 68 and 84; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- IN-RENEW-A-COUNT — knowledge-exam question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-RENEW-A-TIME — knowledge-exam time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-RENEW-D-FIVEYR — late-renewal tier boundary at exactly five years expired (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- IN-RENEW-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- IN-RENEW-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: placard fees, State Form numbers, myBMV.com and kiosk services and the online replacement limit (for example sec04-F35, sec04-R11) can change and must be refreshed from IN.gov/BMV.
